chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the ṣarūrah: "May he perform hajj using zakat funds?" He said: "Yes."

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الصَّرُورَةِ: a person who has not yet performed hajj
key_terms.حَرِيزٌ: Ḥarīz, a narrator in the sanad
key_terms.مَالِ الزَّكَاةِ: zakat funds or wealth designated as zakat
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ: Muḥammad ibn Muslim, the transmitter asking the Imam

ai.seo_question: Can someone who has not yet performed hajj use zakat funds to go for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about whether a ṣarūrah, one who has not yet performed hajj, may perform hajj using zakat funds. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام answers in the affirmative, indicating the permissibility of this use in the context mentioned.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2879 - Hariz narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a ṣarūra (one who has not performed Hajj): "Can they perform Hajj using Zakat funds?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."
